name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Marketing Automation Manager | Lifecycle Journeys & CRM Systems
summary: Marketing operations leader and CRM architect with 15+ years in marketing and revenue operations, including 5+ years building CRM and marketing-automation systems - segmentation, triggers, personalization, and multi-step journeys - primarily in GoHighLevel, with hands-on HubSpot and Salesforce experience across client-facing roles. Brings a QA mindset and cross-functional fluency (Sales, Product, RevOps) built over a decade in B2B SaaS account and partnership roles before moving into hands-on automation building.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Architect and implement complex CRM systems in GoHighLevel and HubSpot - contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, triggers, and strict data-hygiene protocols.

Architected a complete marketing-automation system - 20+ workflows spanning lead capture/tagging/routing, lead qualification, triggered appointment booking with confirmation and reminders, no-show recovery, post-sale onboarding nurture, long-term nurture/reactivation, and automated review-generation sequences.
Built segmented, triggered outreach campaigns (website-visibility, missed-calls, and low-reviews) plus an automated audit workflow that enrolled 180+ contacts based on scored engagement signals.
Design self-improving loops and evaluation frameworks to monitor automation outputs and continuously optimize conversion rates, catching and correcting broken logic before it reaches customers.
Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable in GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, keeping campaign and project records auditable across concurrent engagements.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, delivering insights to business-owner stakeholders.
Translate non-technical stakeholders' generalized ideas and feedback into precise, structured automation logic - acting as the bridge between business intent and reliable system behavior.
Break down manual marketing workflows into automated, rule-based logic that scores engagement signals and triggers the right next step without manual intervention.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.
Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, translating performance data into strategic recommendations.
Ran Google keyword research and search-term analysis to shape campaign targeting and content direction.
Held delivery quality consistent across implementations, resolving client feedback promptly to protect satisfaction and retention.

Developed scalable communication workflows and automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority customer feedback informing the roadmap.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.

bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month on Salesforce-backed workflows, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists, overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Sold and scoped complex CRM and project-management software to agencies and professional-services firms, with deep fluency in sales enablement, contact management, and pipeline automation.
Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and handed them to the implementation team to execute against.
